ui.cancel_hint: Stop the scan; results found so far are kept
ui.export_hint: Write the full findings list to a JSON report
ui.refresh_disks_hint: Re-read the mount table and free-space figures
ui.targets_hint: Choose which disks and folders a scan walks
ui.add_folder_hint: Add any directory as an extra scan target
ui.filter_tooltip: Substring match on the full path. Press / to focus

ui.filter_safe_hint: Only what regenerates on its own
ui.filter_review_hint: Only what costs a re-download or a rebuild
ui.filter_risky_hint: Only what cannot be recreated automatically
ui.everything_found_sub: Pick a category on the left to work through them one at a time.
ui.select_safe_hint: Tick every safe cache shown. Review-only and risky items are never included
ui.risky_locked_hint: Risky items are excluded from bulk selection — open the row to delete it deliberately
ui.empty_body: Chystik finds caches, build outputs and downloads you can safely delete.
ui.empty_filtered_body: No item matches the current filters.
ui.scanning_body: Results appear as they are found.
ui.move_to_trash_hint: Nothing is erased: items go to your desktop trash and stay restorable
ui.cleanup_unavailable: Cleanup is unavailable on this platform until its native trash safety checks are verified
ui.disks_hint: Mounted volumes and how full they are
ui.guard_will_skip: {n} will be skipped: the safety guard refuses them.
ui.esc_to_cancel: Esc to cancel · Enter to confirm
ui.consent_lead: Chystik deletes files. Read this once, then it will not ask again.
ui.consent_p1_body: Everything you select goes to your desktop trash, where you can put it back.
ui.consent_p2_title: Every item is rated by what losing it costs
ui.consent_p2_body: Safe regenerates on its own. Moderate costs a re-download or a rebuild. Risky cannot be recreated automatically.
ui.consent_p3_title: Risky items are never selected in bulk
ui.consent_p3_body: You have to tick each one yourself, deliberately.
ui.consent_p4_body: System directories, .git, .ssh, .gnupg and your settings are rejected by a guard that runs before every deletion.
ui.consent_p5_body: Chystik shows a full manifest before it deletes anything. Read it — the rules can be wrong about your machine.
ui.consent_checkbox: I understand, and I will review the list before confirming a deletion
ui.exclusions_hint: Excluded folders are not scanned, not shown and never deleted.
ui.exclusions_unreadable: The exclusion list could not be read — nothing is excluded this session.
ui.shown_advisory: {size} more needs a command you run yourself
ui.policy_direct_safe: Chystik can move this exact cache to Trash
ui.policy_direct_review: Review this item before moving it to Trash
ui.policy_advisory_only: Chystik only describes this system-managed space
ui.policy_vendor_command_only: Clean this through the owning tool, not Chystik
ui.disks_idle_explain: Space that exists but no tool can see — df, your file manager and Chystik's own scan all ignore an unmounted partition.
ui.privacy_lead: Not about space — about what these files say about you. Every row states what it reveals and what clearing it costs.
ui.privacy_nothing_preselected: Nothing is selected by default. Erasing your own history is a decision per item.
ui.privacy_confirm_lead: This is not disk cleanup. You are erasing a record of what you did, and some of it does not come back.
ui.privacy_confirm_trash: Everything goes to the trash first, so it stays recoverable until you empty it.
ui.privacy_confirm_risky: {n} of these cannot be recreated in any useful sense.

build_artifacts.label: Build artifacts
build_artifacts.description: Compiler and bundler output inside your projects: node_modules, target, dist. Rebuilt by the project's own build command, at the cost of compile time.

package_caches.label: Package caches
package_caches.description: Downloaded dependencies kept by package managers. Re-fetched automatically on the next install; you only pay bandwidth.

ide_toolchains.label: IDE & toolchains
ide_toolchains.description: Editor indexes and downloaded SDKs, runtimes and toolchains. Rebuilt or re-downloaded, but a build can fail until it is.

ai_models.label: AI models
ai_models.description: Local model weights. Often tens of gigabytes, slow to fetch, and sometimes no longer published — treat every one as a deliberate decision.

browser_system.label: Browser & system
browser_system.description: Browser caches, thumbnails and desktop shader caches. Refilled during normal use with no action from you.

android_dev.label: Android dev
android_dev.description: Emulator images, SDK system images and superseded Studio copies. Large, and re-downloaded through the SDK manager.

ai_agents.label: AI agents
ai_agents.description: Coding-agent session logs, transcripts and downloaded agent runtimes. Transcripts are conversation history and do not come back.

containers.label: Containers
containers.description: User-level container engine caches and images. Rebuilt or pulled again; named volumes are never targeted.

installers.label: Installers
installers.description: Archives and packages left behind after installation: .deb, AppImage, .vsix. The installed software is unaffected.

game_launchers.label: Games
game_launchers.description: Shader caches, client logs and update payloads from game launchers. Installed games and saves are never targeted.

media_apps.label: Media
media_apps.description: Render caches and preview proxies from video and audio tools. Regenerated on the next render, which takes time.

messengers.label: Messengers
messengers.description: Received-media caches from chat apps. Message history itself is out of scope.

cloud_sync.label: Cloud sync
cloud_sync.description: Transfer queues, conflict copies and metadata databases from sync clients. Your synced files are never targeted.

office_docs.label: Office
office_docs.description: Recovery data, locks and thumbnail caches from office and note apps. Documents themselves are out of scope.

system_junk.label: System junk
system_junk.description: Crash dumps, stale indexes, orphaned thumbnails and the desktop trash. Regenerated or already discarded.

moderate.label: Moderate
moderate.cost: needs a re-download or a rebuild
